sample_unit: raters (30 participants rated 12 responses; 100 synthetic queries evaluated automatically)
models_evaluated: OpenAI GPT with Qdrant vector database (RAG)

links.outcome: Automated RAGAS relevancy, contextual precision, and faithfulness of RAG chatbot answers to retrieved sources
links.effect: Answer relevancy mean 0.864 (SD 0.223), contextual precision 0.891 (SD 0.201), faithfulness 0.853 (SD 0.171); no non-RAG comparator reported.
links.quote: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Assessment Scale evaluation confirmed strong technical performance for answer relevancy (mean 0.864, SD 0.223), contextual precision (mean 0.891, SD 0.201), and faithfulness (mean 0.853, SD 0.171).

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a RAG-based chatbot for orthopedic patient education using expert/user ratings and automated benchmark metrics, but does not compare outcomes with vs. without a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
